verdict.rationale: Dagster's core asset/resource framework lets engineers define custom data pulls as Python code (dagster-docs-1, dagster-docs-17/19), and the first-party dlt integration (DltLoadCollectionComponent) is explicitly designed to represent custom-built connectors for arbitrary/long-tail sources as Dagster assets without forking (dagster-docs-10/22/30). This is a supported, documented path rather than a fork-based workaround. Missing for 10: a dedicated end-to-end tutorial/example specifically building a long-tail API connector, and independent/hands-on community corroboration of this exact workflow (one comment notes Dagster's pre-built connector catalog is thinner than Airflow's, dagster-comm-3, though that concerns breadth of ready-made connectors, not custom-build capability).
